short_description: Experimental sensitive-lifestyle trait retained for research inspection of cannabis-use score behavior within the strict no-imputation raw-array workflow; it is not consumer-ready.
summary_note: Experimental non-consumer lifestyle trait used to inspect how a cannabis-use-related score behaves under the current strict raw-array workflow without imputation.
what_it_measures: A panel-relative polygenic signal associated with the bundled cannabis-use score, calibrated within the current local empirical reference panel for research inspection only.
interpretation_template: This is an experimental research-facing output, not a prediction of actual substance use, not a behavioral label, and not a recommendation about cannabis. {interpretation}
caution_text: Experimental research output only. No imputation or ancestry-adjusted normalization is used, and the result should not be treated as a prediction of substance use, a behavioral label, or personal advice.
limitations: Percentiles and z-scores are relative to the local reference panel, not to a population-wide benchmark.
This trait is not consumer-ready and should stay in research review unless a separate product decision is made.
Real-world cannabis use depends heavily on access, law, culture, age, peer environment, health context, and personal choices, so this output should not be read as a deterministic behavior forecast.
confidence_note: Confidence reflects overlap and reference robustness under the no-imputation raw-array workflow, not certainty about real-world behavior.
reference_note: Percentiles and z-scores are calibrated against a local empirical reference artifact built from raw-array files in this project; they are panel-relative research values, not population-wide or behavioral benchmarks.
